headlines.title: What to know about Pope Leo’s lung surgery
headlines.description: The Vatican said the procedure was done “successfully” and that the 71-year-old Leo had returned to his room at Rome’s Gemelli hospital.

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: The secret to a good night’s rest? Let sleeping dogs lie — next to you
headlines.description: A surprising new study found that people who sleep near their dogs don’t experience disrupted sleep. If anything we humans are the ones disturbing our dogs’ sleep.

headlines.title: An AI-powered chip allows an amputee to control his robot prosthetic with his mind
headlines.description: A first-of-its-kind implant is helping an amputee control technology with his thoughts and even regain a sense of touch. Researchers say the breakthrough could transform prosthetics and human-machine interaction.

headlines.title: Doctor says Pope Leo has 'one of the more treatable' cancers
headlines.description: The Vatican announced that Pope Leo has been diagnosed with lung cancer following surgery to remove a lung nodule, during which doctors removed the lower lobe of his right lung. NBC News medical contributor Dr. John Torres says that the type of cancer, ​lung adenocarcinoma, is "one of the more treatable" types of cancers, and a treatment course will be prescribed following more testing by the pontiff's medical team.

headlines.title: Pennsylvania health officials report a sixth measles-related death
headlines.description: Pennsylvania is at the center of the nation’s largest measles outbreak in three decades, with a sixth measles-related death reported as cases continue to surge. NBC News’ Erika Edwards shares the latest developments in the outbreak and what to know about vaccinations.

headlines.title: Terry Crews on Using His Platform to Advocate for Mental Health
headlines.description: Actor and mental health advocate Terry Crews and Project Healthy Minds founder and CEO Phil Schermer, join Saturday TODAY to discuss their flagship event on World Mental Health Day. Crews also shares how he uses his platform to encourage others to get the help they need and reflects on how mental health issues have been destigmatized over the years.

headlines.title: Biossance’s popular squalane oil is just $19 for the next 36 hours — shop while supplies last
headlines.description: Biossance’s squalane oil is currently 44% off, bringing it down to under $19 — the perfect time to stock up on a hydrating oil for the dry skin season ahead.

headlines.title: We’ve tested hundreds of oral care products — these 50 are the most effective
headlines.description: We tested popular and lesser known toothpastes, whitening strips, water flossers and other oral care products to find the 50 best of the year.

headlines.title: This is how you should actually be cleaning your glasses
headlines.description: I found the best methods and products for cleaning glasses, including reading glasses, sunglasses and more. Optometrists recommend the best cleaning products.

headlines.title: The best products for treating keratosis pilaris
headlines.description: Tired of rough, bumpy skin? Discover expert-recommended best keratosis pilaris treatments for smoother, softer skin.

headlines.title: Is it Healthy to Eat Tofu Every Day? Keep These 3 Things in Mind, Dietitian Says
headlines.description: Tofu is packed with plant protein, minerals and antioxidant plant compounds. But is it healthy to eat tofu every day? A dietitian explains what to keep in mind.
